description: Universal quality standard defining common fields used by every QA/QC/Tester policy.

non_negotiable_rules.description: Technical metrics passing (blur, brightness, contrast) does NOT constitute visual quality acceptance. Only operator visual review can approve visual output.
No agent, script, or CLI may create, emulate, or pre-fill an operator visual or production decision. Operator decisions must originate from a real human operator.
production_accepted may only be set to true after the final human operator has explicitly approved the output for production.
Every visual output intended for downstream use must pass through explicit human operator visual review.
Retries must be planned with explicit corrective changes. Blind identical retries are forbidden.
No voice generation, assembly, or downstream processing may occur without passing all required gates including operator review.
artifact_index.json, episode_ledger.json, and git commit history are the canonical source of truth for project state.
